restoredAfterwards.workspace.LegacyCourses: seven models restored to their recorded Y 0 pivots (ServerStorage.LegacyCourseParkRecord)

TumbleTunnels.method: CourseAuthoring.preview put an unregistered clone at the live MapOrigin; the clone alone was lifted 9,000 studs, the camera was posed through workspace.CurrentCamera at FieldOfView 70, and the viewport was grabbed to a real PNG. clearPreview() removed the clone afterwards; workspace.Assets.Arena.Map.Model was never moved and is still at its recorded pivot.

note: Fixed-camera captures for HANDOFF 8.6, one entry per course. The prescribed offsets are relative to the course's own origin: top-down eye (0,520,1) looking at (0,20,0); three-quarter eye (300,260,300) looking at (0,20,0), both at 70 degrees. The preview is lifted 9,000 studs above MapOrigin for the shots, because the arena's own hazard ring and PvP floor sit at MapOrigin and fill the frame; the camera offsets are unchanged, so the framing is the prescribed one with an empty background.
